name: rimworld/set_hover_target
title: Rimworld Set Hover Target
description: Set a bounded virtual cursor/hover target for UI review and screenshots, using a ui-element or screen target id, explicit screen coordinates, or a current-map cell, pawn, or thing

targetId.description: Optional ui-element target id returned by rimworld/get_ui_layout, or a screen target id from rimworld/get_screen_targets

x.description: Current-map cell x coordinate when hovering a map cell

z.description: Current-map cell z coordinate when hovering a map cell

thingId.description: Stable current-map thing id when hovering a spawned thing

pawnName.description: Optional current-map pawn name when hovering a pawn

pawnId.description: Optional stable current-map pawn id when hovering a pawn

anchor.description: Anchor inside target rectangles for targetId: center, top, bottom, left, right, topLeft, topRight, bottomLeft, or bottomRight

offsetX.description: Logical-pixel horizontal offset added after resolving the target point or map point

offsetY.description: Logical-pixel vertical offset added after resolving the target point or map point

screenX.description: Explicit screen-space x coordinate, in RimWorld UI logical pixels, when no targetId or map target is supplied

screenY.description: Explicit screen-space y coordinate, in RimWorld UI logical pixels from the top edge, when no targetId or map target is supplied

durationMs.description: Optional lifetime for the virtual cursor in milliseconds. Values are clamped to a safe bounded range and real mouse input clears it immediately.

settleMs.description: Optional post-hover wait in milliseconds so repaint-driven hover effects and RimWorld's normal tooltip delay can become visible before follow-up screenshots. Values are clamped to a safe bounded range.

name: rimworld/clear_hover_target
title: Rimworld Clear Hover Target
description: Clear the current virtual cursor/hover target so screenshots, mouseover-driven UI, and map clicks return to the real cursor state
